arxiv-2106-00075.title: Variational Combinatorial Sequential Monte Carlo Methods for Bayesian Phylogenetic Inference
arxiv-2106-00075.creator: Antonio Khalil Moretti, Liyi Zhang, Christian A. Naesseth, Hadiah Venner, David Blei, Itsik Pe’er
arxiv-2106-00075.description: Abstract Bayesian phylogenetic inference is often conducted via local or sequential search over topologies and branch lengths using algorithms such as random-walk Markov chain Monte Carlo ( Mcmc ) or Combinatorial Sequential Monte Carlo ( Csmc ). However, when Mcmc is used for evolutionary parameter learning, convergence requires long runs with inefficient exploration of the state space.

arxiv-2110-10633.title: Mitigating stellar activity jitter with different line lists for least-squares deconvolution: analysis of a parametric and a randomised line selection
arxiv-2110-10633.creator: S. Bellotti, P. Petit, J. Morin, G. A. J. Hussain, C. P. Folsom, A. Carmona, X. Delfosse, C. Moutou
arxiv-2110-10633.description: Abstract Context. Stellar activity limits the radial velocity (RV) search and characterisation of exoplanets, as it introduces spurious noise (called “jitter”) in the data sets and prevents the correct retrieval of a planetary signal. This is key for M dwarfs, considering that they manifest high activity levels and are primary targets for present and future searches of habitable Earth-like planets.

arxiv-2306-08367.title: Accelerating Machine Learning Queries with Linear Algebra Query Processing Conference: 35th International Conference on Scientific and Statistical Database Management; July 10–12, 2023; Los Angeles, CA, USA 35th International Conference on Scientific and Statistical Database Management (SSDBM 2023),
arxiv-2306-08367.creator: Wenbo Sun, Asterios Katsifodimos, Rihan Hai
arxiv-2306-08367.description: Abstract . The rapid growth of large-scale machine learning (ML) models has led numerous commercial companies to utilize ML models for generating predictive results to help business decision-making. As two primary components in traditional predictive pipelines, data processing, and model predictions often operate in separate execution environments, leading to redundant engineering and computations.

arxiv-2308-08431.title: Integrating Visual and Semantic Similarity Using Hierarchies for Image Retrieval
arxiv-2308-08431.creator: Aishwarya Venkataramanan[✉], Martin Laviale, Cédric Pradalier
arxiv-2308-08431.description: Abstract Most of the research in content-based image retrieval (CBIR) focus on developing robust feature representations that can effectively retrieve instances from a database of images that are visually similar to a query. However, the retrieved images sometimes contain results that are not semantically related to the query.

arxiv-2401-14601.title: A stabilizer free weak Galerkin method with implicit θ \theta -schemes for fourth order parabolic problems
arxiv-2401-14601.creator: Shanshan Gu, Qilong Zhai
arxiv-2401-14601.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shanshan Gu, Qilong Zhai. In this paper, we combine the stabilizer free weak Galerkin (SFWG) method and the implicit θ \theta -schemes in time for θ ∈ [ 1 2 , 1 ] \theta\in[\frac{1}{2},1] to solve the fourth-order parabolic problem. In particular, when θ = 1 \theta=1 , the full-discrete scheme is first-order backward Euler and the scheme is second-order Crank Nicolson scheme if θ = 1 2 \theta=\frac{1}{2} .

arxiv-2403-15356.title: Neural Plasticity-Inspired Multimodal Foundation Model for Earth Observation
arxiv-2403-15356.creator: Zhitong Xiong, Yi Wang, Fahong Zhang, Adam J. Stewart, Joëlle Hanna, Damian Borth, Ioannis Papoutsis, Bertrand Le Saux, Gustau Camps-Valls, Xiao Xiang Zhu
arxiv-2403-15356.description: Abstract The development of foundation models has revolutionized our ability to interpret the Earth’s surface using satellite observational data. Traditional models have been siloed, tailored to specific sensors or data types like optical, radar, and hyperspectral, each with unique characteristics.

arxiv-2404-06412.title: Gravitational wave asteroseismology of charged strange stars in the Cowling approximation: the fluid pulsation modes
arxiv-2404-06412.creator: José D. V. Arbañil e1,addr1,addr2, César H. Lenzi addr3, Juan M. Z. Pretel addr4, César O. V. Flores addr5,addr6
arxiv-2404-06412.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by José D. V. Arbañil e1,addr1,addr2, César H. Lenzi addr3, Juan M. Z. Pretel addr4, César O. V. Flores addr5,addr6. In this work we study, within the framework of Cowling approximation, the effect of the electric charge on the gravitational wave frequency of fluid oscillation modes of strange quark stars.

arxiv-2503-11906.title: A Survey on SAR ship classification using Deep Learning
arxiv-2503-11906.creator: Ch Muhammad Awais 1 2 3 , Marco Reggiannini 2 3 , Davide Moroni 2 , and Emanuele Salerno 2
arxiv-2503-11906.description: Abstract Deep learning (DL) has emerged as a powerful tool for Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) ship classification. This survey comprehensively analyzes the diverse DL techniques employed in this domain. We identify critical trends and challenges, highlighting the importance of integrating handcrafted features, utilizing public datasets, data augmentation, fine-tuning, explainability techniques, and fostering interdisciplinary collaborations to improve DL model performance.

arxiv-2512-08861.title: Cultural evolution of human beauty standards
arxiv-2512-08861.creator: Louis Boucherie, Sagar Kumar, Katharina Ledebur, August Lohse, Karolina Śliwa
arxiv-2512-08861.description: Abstract Beauty standards shape self-perception and health through social comparison and objectification 19 , 22 , while exposure to idealized imagery exacerbates body-image concerns 23 , 20 . Media and fashion are central arbiters of these ideals 18 , yet long-term, quantitative, intersectional studies on how representation has changed remain scarce.

pmc-11363273.title: Correlated variability and its attentional modulation depend on anatomical connectivity
pmc-11363273.creator: Shraddha Shah, Jacqueline Hembrook-Short, Vanessa Mock, Farran Briggs
pmc-11363273.description: SignificanceThe term “functional connectivity” has been increasingly used to describe correlated variability across neurons and brain regions. Whether correlated variability between neurons is dependent upon their anatomical connections has not been explicitly tested. We examined correlated spiking variability, and its attentional modulation, among visual cortical neurons sharing different types of anatomical connections.

pmc-11395962.title: Investigation of hydrochemical characteristic, water quality and associated health risks of metals and metalloids in water resources in the vicinity of Akamkpa quarry district, southeastern, Nigeria
pmc-11395962.creator: George E Ikpi, Therese N Nganje, Aniekan Edet, Christopher I Adamu, Godswill A Eyong
pmc-11395962.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Quarrying of rock aggregates generates produced water that, if not handled properly will be a source of pollution for nearby water bodies, thus affecting the chemistry of the water. This study examined the chemistry, impact of quarrying activities on water resources and the health consequences/risks posed by ingestion of the water by humans in the Akamkpa quarry region in southeastern Nigeria.

pmc-11401368.title: Assessing emergency room leadership of ObGyn residents in a public university teaching hospital of Sindh, Pakistan: a cross-sectional survey
pmc-11401368.creator: Nusrat Shah, Nighat Shah, Umm-e Rabab, Hira Tariq, Samina Ayaz, Tanzila Fahim
pmc-11401368.description: BackgroundLeadership is a critical competency for medical professionals, yet it is often neglected in medical training. For ObGyn residents, leadership training is particularly crucial as it significantly impacts both maternal and newborn outcomes, as well as the operational efficiency of healthcare teams.

pmc-11422169.title: Regulated and adaptive in vivo insulin secretion from islets only containing β-cells
pmc-11422169.creator: Marta Perez-Frances, Eva Bru-Tari, Christian Cohrs, Maria Valentina Abate, Léon van Gurp, Kenichiro Furuyama, Stephan Speier, Fabrizio Thorel, Pedro L. Herrera
pmc-11422169.description: Insulin-producing β-cells in pancreatic islets are regulated by systemic cues and, locally, by adjacent islet hormone-producing ‘non-β-cells’ (namely α-cells, δ-cells and γ-cells). Yet whether the non-β-cells are required for accurate insulin secretion is unclear. Here, we studied mice in which adult islets are exclusively composed of β-cells and human pseudoislets containing only primary β-cells.

pmc-11470193.title: Assessment of usage, reuse and disposal of thermoplastic masks among radiotherapy technologists in India: A nationwide perspective
pmc-11470193.creator: M Nagesh, Rohit Vadgaonkar, KK Sreelakshmi, Raghavendra Hajare, Pritam Parab, Subhabrat Dash, Ramesh Reddy, Vaishali Shende, Ankita Nawar, Rahul Biswas, Sandeep Ratna Bula, Shubham Gagare, Darshani Belekar, Raviteja Miriyala, Umesh Mahantshetty
pmc-11470193.description: Highlights•The study addresses a literature gap on the utilization, reuse and disposal of thermoplastic masks.•Thermoplastic masks are often reused in curative treatments, government-run and busy centres.•The preferred way of disposal of used thermoplastic masks is through biomedical waste management.•Radiotherapy technologists are conscious for environmental effects of thermoplastic mask disposal.

pmc-12940622.title: Flavomycin inhibits plasmid-mediated conjugative transfer of antibiotic resistance genes by disrupting energy metabolism and pilus assembly
pmc-12940622.creator: Yi-Yun Liu, Min Liao, Yu-Jie Li, Cai-Ying Lin, Ruo-Rou Qian, Jing-Hao Liu, Jia-Kuo Chen, Hui-Ying Yue, Xin-Lei Lian, Ying Huang, Jian-Hua Liu
pmc-12940622.description: The rapid global dissemination of multidrug-resistant (MDR) bacteria, primarily driven by horizontal gene transfer through conjugative plasmids, poses a significant challenge to modern medicine. Conjugation enables the efficient spread of antibiotic resistance genes across bacterial populations, severely compromising the efficacy of existing therapies.

pmc-13095280.title: Prophylactic tirofiban versus oral dual antiplatelet therapy in patients undergoing endovascular treatment of intracranial aneurysms: A meta-analysis
pmc-13095280.creator: Yvlu Miao, Qiming Li, Jiaqi Chen, Zike Liu
pmc-13095280.description: Background:Endovascular treatment of intracranial aneurysms carries the risk of perioperative thromboembolism and bleeding, and the optimal prophylactic antiplatelet strategy remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of prophylactic tirofiban administration compared with oral dual antiplatelet (DAP) therapy.

pmc-13141211.title: A diagnosis and treatment algorithm for adnexal masses in female children and adolescents
pmc-13141211.creator: Liying Sun, Jiayu Shen, Symphorosa S C Chan, Karen Ng, Ani Amelia Zainuddin, Zoran Stankovic, Yasmin Jayasinghe, Sonia Grover, Hafizur Rahman, Huihui Gao
pmc-13141211.description: ynecology Scientific Congress. Adnexal masses in female children and adolescents encompass a wide spectrum of ovarian and tubal lesions, which may be malignant or benign. In this population, early identification to allow clarification if surgical intervention is necessary, and to allow for fertility protection, is an important challenge.

pmc-13142719.title: The Combined Predictive Value of the GRACE Score and the ARC-HBR Criteria for Bleeding Risk After Percutaneous Coronary Intervention in STEMI Patients
pmc-13142719.creator: Xiaoying Wang, Yuanyuan Ning, Xiaojuan Wang, Guangli Li, Dong Wu, Xiaowu Wang, Zhen Huang
pmc-13142719.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the incremental predictive value of the Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events (GRACE) score combined with the Academic Research Consortium for High Bleeding Risk (ARC-HBR) criteria for bleeding risk after percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) in patients with ST‑segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI).

pmc-13372909.title: Stem cell factor 248 shapes ILC2 transcriptional programs and promotes mucosal inflammation in allergic asthma
pmc-13372909.creator: Nobuhiro Asai, Grace K. Lombardo, Ramon Ocadiz-Ruiz, Yao Gu, Andrew J. Rasky, Dana S. Garcia, Angela J. Montoya, Sarita Montaño, Kazuma Yagi, Wendy Fonseca
pmc-13372909.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Stem cell factor (SCF), also known as Kit ligand, is a pleiotropic cytokine that signals through the c-Kit receptor to regulate cellular development, survival, and proliferation. Although SCF is classically recognized for its essential role in hematopoiesis and mast cell biology, c-Kit is also expressed by innate lymphoid cell progenitors (ILCp) and subsets of mature innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), suggesting broader immunoregulatory functions.Group 2 innate lymphoid cells (ILC2s) are critical mediators of type 2 airway inflammation and serve as an important source

pmc-13408754.title: Adult-Onset Recessive Cerebellar Ataxia and Severe Multisystem Disease-Associated Genes: Hypomorphic Alleles and Clinical Interpretation Pitfalls
pmc-13408754.creator: Lorenzo Cipriano, Roberta Petillo, Manuela Priolo, Paola D’Ambrosio
pmc-13408754.description: Background: Adult-onset recessive cerebellar ataxias remain frequently unresolved after next-generation sequencing, partly because phenotype-driven filtering can deprioritize biallelic variants in genes historically associated with severe pediatric multisystem disease. This review examines how attenuated, hypomorphic, or residual-function genotypes may present as late-onset, cerebellar-predominant disease and aims to support clinical interpretation of apparently discordant recessive findings.

pmc-13542690.title: Surgical Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation Using the Left Atrial Roof Approach
pmc-13542690.creator: Joon Young Kim, Joon Bum Kim
pmc-13542690.description: BackgroundMinimally invasive surgical ablation has demonstrated favorable outcomes when performed during mitral and tricuspid valve procedures; however, its application in proximal aortic and aortic valve procedures remains challenging. We present the left atrial (LA) roof approach via upper mini-sternotomy as an alternative technique.

pmc-13564027.title: Metal-Free Photoinduced Hydrogen Atom Transfer for Direct Thiolation of Hydridic α‑C(sp3)–H of Ethers
pmc-13564027.creator: Alexander Karr, Elias Picazo
pmc-13564027.description: C–S bond formation via hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) remains underdeveloped despite the importance of thioethers in organic synthesis, materials science, and medicinal chemistry. Herein, we report a mild, rapid, and operationally simple method for the direct α-C­(sp3)–S bond formation in ethers using alkyl or aryl thiosulfonates as sulfur sources and (4-methoxyphenyl)­(4-(trifluoromethyl)­phenyl)­methanone as the diaryl ketone catalyst.
